title: MEMOBench: A Process Level Memory Benchmark for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.07047v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robotic manipulation often requires acting on information that is no longer visible, yet Vision-Language-Action policies are usually evaluated when the current observation largely determines the next action. Existing robotic memory benchmarks expose this gap, but they still rely mainly on final task success and therefore conflate forgetting with manipulation failure. We present \textbf{MEMOBench}, a benchmark for process level memory evaluation in robotic manipulation. MEMOBench includes 30 history dependent tasks, 1{,}500 expert demonstrations, and 4{,}200 executable checkpoint instances from 84 templates. Each checkpoint pairs coarse to fine language with a simulator predicate and labels one memory operation: Storage, Update, or Compression. translated_title: MEMOBench：面向机器人操作的过程级记忆基准测试
translated_abstract: 机器人操作常常需要对已经不可见的信息采取行动，然而视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常是在当前观测基本决定下一个动作的场景下进行评估的。现有的机器人记忆基准虽然揭示了这一差距，但它们主要仍依赖最终任务是否成功来评判，因此将记忆遗忘与操作失败混为一谈。我们提出了MEMOBench，一个面向机器人操作中过程级记忆评估的基准。MEMOBench包含30个依赖历史的任务、1,500条专家演示，以及来自84个模板的4,200个可执行检查点实例。每个检查点将粗到细粒度的语言指令与模拟器谓词配对，并标注一种记忆操作类型：存储、更新或压缩。这些标注定义了记忆存储率、记忆更新率和记忆压缩率三项指标，与任务成功率共同衡量记忆的保真度。在标准VLA策略和记忆增强VLA策略上的实验……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MEMOBench提出了一个机器人操作过程级记忆评估基准，通过30个依赖历史的任务和记忆存储率、更新率、压缩率三项指标，将记忆保真度评估与任务成功率解耦。
en_tdlr: MEMOBench introduces a process-level memory benchmark for robotic manipulation that decouples memory fidelity from task success by evaluating Memory Storage, Update, and Compression Rates across 30 history-dependent tasks.
